findings.description: The inline policy grants full wildcard actions (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, cloudwatch:*) on all resources ("Resource": "*") to the IAM user, violating least privilege and allowing broad account-wide access if the user's credentials are compromised.

An IAM access key (long-lived static credential) is created for a human/service IAM user rather than relying on temporary role-based credentials, increasing the risk of credential leakage and misuse since these keys do not expire or rotate automatically.

findings.issue_category: sensitive credential material exposed via output
findings.description: The 'secret' output exposes aws_iam_access_key.user.encrypted_secret, surfacing sensitive key material in Terraform state/output logs; combined with the overly permissive attached policy, exposure of this value would grant broad account access.
